mandatory_audits: MODEL_CARD model label and production configuration present
proper-rotation, reflection, translation, and atom-permutation invariance preflight passed
dataset audit declares all 15 fold-seed trainings and the complete prediction table
exact model, target, fold, and seed sets
complete record coverage for every seed and target
exact frozen fold and graph-cluster assignments
recordwise availability of all three seeds

aggregation.order: average y_pred for each record/fold/target across seeds 11, 22, and 33 before computing errors or pair differences
aggregation.pair_weighting: pair weighted while retaining graph clusters during bootstrap

overall.metric: mean absolute error of recordwise seed-averaged OOF predictions

corrected_different_shape.cohort: 151 frozen same-attributed-2D-graph pairs with corrected different best-shape labels
corrected_different_shape.primary_requested_subset: 60 material HOMO-LUMO-gap pairs in 45 graph clusters
metrics: direction concordance with prediction ties scored 0.5 over material pairs
prediction tie rate over material pairs

cis_trans.predefined_material_sensitivity: absolute observed target difference strictly greater than 1.0 D or 0.1 eV
metrics: MAE of the signed cis-minus-trans pair difference
direction concordance with prediction ties scored 0.5

uncertainty.bootstrap_method: ordinary nonparametric attributed-2D-graph-cluster bootstrap, retaining every record or pair in each sampled cluster
uncertainty.paired_test: two-sided paired sign-flip randomization test on the mean within-pair difference in absolute signed-pair-difference error

reporting_rule: Report every listed endpoint and cohort regardless of which model it favors; do not tune, select, or rename cohorts after production ViSNet predictions are read.
claim_boundary: ViSNet and SchNet receive optimized Cartesian coordinates and therefore contain extra information relative to the attributed-2D-graph and CoordRep-field models.
The comparison is common-cohort and common-split, not an equal-input representation ablation.
The group split is by frozen attributed 2D graph, not a family-disjoint chemical-scaffold split.
The cis/trans records support structural discrimination and retrospective property recovery, not a causal claim that a relation token is the only origin of a property difference.
No endpoint establishes universal superiority over graph or equivariant neural networks.
